gemini.prompt:
You are extracting expense data from payment screenshots.
Available categories: {categories}

Extract ALL expense items visible in the image and return a JSON array. Each object must have these fields:
  "name": item name (string)
  "money": total paid in VND (int)
  "shop": seller/payee name (string)
  "suggested_category": best match from the category list above (string)
  "payment_source": one of "shopee", "bank_transfer", "other" (string)

If the image is not a payment receipt or no expenses are found, return {{"error": "No expenses found"}}.
Return ONLY valid JSON, no markdown fences.
